## Summary

**Story #5 — Expose `/clients` endpoints with `/customers` as a deprecated alias** — [issue](https://github.com/dsj1984/bench-sbx-2026-07-24-brownfield-longitudinal-mandrel-72244a0a/issues/5), `agent::ready`, cohort `plan-run::d0e04c48`.

**Pipeline (headless, `--yes`):**
- **Interrogate** — envelope written; codebase snapshot confirmed a layered `routes → services → repositories` API with `customers.routes.js` mounting the five endpoints on one shared `customers.service.js`/`customers.repo.js` data path.
- **Gate #1** — auto-proceeded. A `/deliver-light` suggestion fired (advisory, fits the ≤2-artifact ceiling); recorded, not auto-rerouted — kept it on the full `/plan` path per protocol.
- **Author** — one cohesive Story (single capability slice, no architectural seam to split on).
- **Critics** — consolidation and pre-mortem both skipped (ledgered; 1-story draft, no risk-heuristic or external-dependency hits); text-hygiene clean.
- **Gate #2 / Persist** — dry-run passed every gate; real persist created the issue.

**Plan shape:** Both path families register through one shared handler definition delegating to the existing customers service/repo — so `/clients` is the primary surface and `/customers` stays a fully-functional deprecated alias. The load-bearing invariant is a **single backing store**: no forked data path, no second table, and the `cus_` id scheme preserved — so a record created via one path is identical when read/updated/deleted via the other. Files scoped: `src/routes/customers.routes.js`, `src/app.js`, and a new `tests/clients.test.js`.

Delivery was intentionally **not** run. To deliver: `/deliver 5`.

`status: landed`. Story #5 is delivered — this was a single-Story run, so no epilogue. Relaying the terminal envelope:

## Delivery complete — Epic delivered

**`/deliver 5 --yes`** landed the existing plan. Note: the v2 ticket model is **Story-only** (no `type::epic`), so the planning pipeline's artifact for this change request was Story **#5 — "Expose /clients endpoints with /customers as a deprecated alias"** (`plan-run::d0e04c48`). I delivered it exactly as authored — no re-planning.

**What shipped** (PR #6, squash-merged to `main`, `agent::done`):
- `src/routes/customers.routes.js` — the five handlers are now defined **once** in `registerResourceRoutes(router, basePath)` and mounted under both `/clients` (current) and `/customers` (deprecated alias), so behaviour can't drift. Both delegate to the single `customers.service` → `customers.repo` and the one table; the `cus_` id scheme is untouched.
- `tests/clients.test.js` — 8 tests covering all acceptance criteria, including cross-path data sharing (create via one path, read/delete via the other).

**Gates all green:**
- Fresh maker-blind `acceptance-critic` (routed because the diff touches the `public-api` sensitive class → `high`): **8/8 criteria met**; `acceptance-eval.js` → `proceed`.
- Full suite **134/134**, clients suite 8/8, customers suites 22/22; lint + typecheck clean; close-validation, base-sync, and code review (0 findings) all passed.
